title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
The Threadfin dragonfish (Echiostoma barbatum), a deep-sea hunter from the twilight zone, mastering vision and survival through bioluminescence in near-total darkness (Credit: Zuzana Musilova).

This month’s cover image is provided by the guest editors of the ‘Visual Ecology in Challenging Environments’ Special Feature, which is included in this issue. The feature aims to target the central question of how visual sensory systems cope in extreme and dynamic environments. Across various animal groups, its contributions cover challenging life-histories, such as nocturnality, and anthropogenically induced changes, such as coral reef bleaching and light pollution.
